mobilePlan: Precompute fixed text vectors offline using the matching pinned text model; ship only vision tower plus small text-vector asset. Both q8 vision towers are about 94 MB download each. Download size is not peak memory; ONNX initialization, graph execution, image buffers, browser runtime and caches add memory. Load one candidate at a time, release sessions between trials, and measure Chromium/WebKit startup, warm inference and memory separately. WASM q8 support must be demonstrated by actual inference; native Android/iOS testing remains separate.
accuracyCaveat: Marqo reports fashion retrieval gains, not Closet Current subtype/category/color accuracy. SigLIP 2 semantic/localization improvements are not evidence of fashion classification acceptance. Neither candidate may be promoted without real-photo comparisons and manual-review safety evidence.
